prompt:
EDIT IMAGE 1 ONLY: redraw the game card 青龙偃月斩 (Azure Dragon Crescent Slash) with its ORIGINAL COMPOSITION PRESERVED. Landscape 4:3. Image1 is the composition and pose authority. Images2/3 are broad handmade PAINT STYLE references only (blue-gold portrait/dark-coat portrait), do not copy their identities/clothes/props. Image4 is Heixiang CHARACTER IDENTITY only, not his cup, standing pose, back-carried sword or white background.

ORIGINAL COMPOSITION: huge pale cyan AZURE DRAGON HEAD and neck occupy the TOP HALF, entering from upper/right edge and roaring toward the LEFT, muzzle position and open jaw size unchanged. Heixiang occupies the LOWER-RIGHT quadrant, same relatively smaller scale, cropped at lower body, three-quarter back/side view with torso twisting and head looking left. His TWO black-gloved hands grip the same long pole/weapon at their original separated positions; near forearm extends toward lower-left and the other extends behind toward upper-right. Same diagonal weapon shaft, same silver-gray blade/dragon-shaped fittings placement. A monumental curved PALE CYAN crescent slash crosses the LEFT HALF from lower-left toward the dragon mouth near upper-left/center, same curve, width and edge crop. Keep dragon/head overlap, character silhouette, weapon angle, arm positions and original large open negative space between dragon and character. No pose redesign, no repositioned dragon, no frontal standing portrait or hero-size change.

IDENTITY: Heixiang / 黑像, adult muscular broad-shouldered DARK-SKINNED man, black short hair slicked back fully exposing forehead, amber-gold eye, stitched cheek scar on HIS LEFT cheek (viewer-right when seen). Black long-sleeved tactical suit, black full gloves, coarse silver-gray shoulder armor and orange/brown scarf at neck. In this card keep original sideways expression and turn of head. Borrow reference4's recognisable face, not a random pretty pale boy. No coffee cup, saucer, new sword or extra accessories.

MAKE THE PAINTING CLEARLY ROUGHER AND MORE HAND-DRAWN: quick expressive broad-brush anime/gouache COLOR STUDY, less detailed and less polished. Construct each region from large connected opaque color masses with a handful of wide directional swipes and blunt dabs. Rough handmade boundaries, selective broken brush endings, sparse loose contour accents and small off-register edges. Most surface stays quiet. Large color masses and correct silhouettes establish weight; visible broad purposeful paint strokes, not noise/filter/grain or tiny scratches. NO fine line drawing across the entire dragon, no thousands of hairlike mane curls or scale marks. Dragon mane in 5–7 substantial flowing PAINT masses; head planes in a few light-cyan/cool-teal blocks, mouth as one clear dark-teal shape, teeth grouped with a few large ivory fang marks, one simplified horn shape and eye mark. Maintain recognisable original dragon silhouette and strong roaring mouth with very economical structure. It is a symbolic painted dragon apparition, not a photoreal animal.
Character dark clothing in 3–5 broad black/charcoal planes, forearms/torso with a few muted cool-gray turns, orange scarf with one broad shadow. Shoulder plates and dragon-shaped weapon fittings become several broad silver-gray/teal forms with selected contour marks; no ornament etching, rivet networks, fine reflective glints or muscular micro-shading. Face receives just enough selective bold eyebrow/amber iris/nose/jaw marks to stay Heixiang, no glossy realism.
The crescent slash becomes ONE dominant pale cyan curved mass plus a broken ivory edge and 1–2 broad teal shadow strokes, no smooth bloom, many floating shards or glowing particles. Simplify the few fragments at top-right into at most a couple of broad abstract broken shapes.

BACKGROUND: replace original gradient with two or three broad alternating SOLID muted charcoal-blue and blue-gray color areas, retaining the same open negative spaces. Pure abstract color field, NO actual environment, landscape, sky, mountains, river, floor or buildings. Dragon, crescent blade and motion appear as card-name imagery only. Color palette matte dark blue/charcoal, pale cyan/ivory, cool gray armor and concentrated orange scarf. NO new embellishments or characters. No text, card frame, UI, logos, watermark, polished fantasy splash-art, airbrushed render, 3D gloss, tiny angular facet mosaics, dense fabric folds or all-over surface texture. Preserve original shot while changing painting grammar decisively.
direction: 重置青龙偃月斩卡面，维持原有构图；沿粗手绘与抽象背景、不测试偏好
